coverage.statement:
Wilson County, TN: Atlas holds the public meeting record of 31 of the 35 governing and deciding bodies registered for the county, its cities and towns, its utility districts and authority, its economic development board and its school boards, as of October 21, 2026. Of the 13 bodies that decide land use, 12 are captured. The record is agendas, meeting materials and minutes as the clerk posted them, with the text read from each document locally; it is not yet a classified case record.

Wilson County. Wilson County Board of Zoning Appeals (board of zoning appeals) is captured from January 21, 2021 through October 15, 2026: 70 meetings, agendas and minutes for 66 meetings. Wilson County Board of Commissioners (elected board) is captured from January 24, 2021 through October 19, 2026: 70 meetings, agendas and minutes for 69 meetings; the portal lists records back to January 16, 2020, before the crawl window. Wilson County committees (County Meetings category: GIS Committee) (board) is captured from January 23, 2025 through January 23, 2025: 1 meetings, agendas. Wilson County Planning Commission (planning commission) is captured from January 22, 2021 through October 16, 2026: 72 meetings, agendas and minutes for 65 meetings.

Lebanon. Lebanon Board of Zoning & Appeals (board of zoning appeals) is captured from January 25, 2021 through September 28, 2026: 36 meetings, agendas; the portal lists records back to January 23, 2012, before the crawl window. Lebanon Industrial Development Board (economic development board) is captured from January 25, 2023 through June 17, 2026: 14 meetings, agendas and minutes for 7 meetings. Lebanon City Council (elected board) is captured from January 5, 2021 through October 20, 2026: 169 meetings, agendas and minutes for 7 meetings; the portal lists records back to March 21, 2017, before the crawl window. Note: Agendas since 2017; the current council agenda is served as an image-only copier scan (OCR'd locally); minutes are not posted for the Council (one committee only). Lebanon Airport Commission (board) is captured from January 7, 2021 through October 1, 2026: 97 meetings, agendas and minutes for 92 meetings; the portal lists records back to August 6, 2020, before the crawl window. Lebanon Historic Preservation Commission (board) is captured from January 20, 2021 through August 11, 2026: 55 meetings, agendas and minutes for 46 meetings; the portal lists records back to July 8, 2014, before the crawl window. Lebanon Planning Commission (planning commission) is captured from January 26, 2021 through September 22, 2026: 72 meetings, agendas and minutes for 71 meetings; the portal lists records back to January 24, 2012, before the crawl window. Lebanon Public Infrastructure Committee (review committee) is captured from May 27, 2025 through July 28, 2026: 11 meetings, agendas and minutes for 9 meetings. Lebanon SP and Annexation Committee (review committee) is captured from April 28, 2025 through April 28, 2025: 1 meetings, agendas.

Mt. Juliet. Mt. Juliet Board of Zoning Appeals (board of zoning appeals) is captured from March 14, 2024 through October 8, 2026: 13 meetings, agendas and minutes for 4 meetings. Note: 2021-01 to 2023-04 not located online -> records request for that window. Mt. Juliet Industrial Development Board (economic development board) is captured from February 14, 2024 through May 13, 2025: 2 meetings, agendas and minutes for 1 meetings. Wilson County Mt. Juliet Development Board (economic development board) is captured from October 2, 2025 through October 2, 2025: 1 meetings, agendas. Mt. Juliet Board of Commissioners (elected board) is captured from May 22, 2023 through September 28, 2026: 83 meetings, agendas and minutes for 68 meetings. City of Mt. Juliet Board of Adjustments & Appeals (board) is captured from August 22, 2024 through August 22, 2024: 1 meetings, agendas. City of Mt. Juliet Ethics Commission (board) is captured from February 21, 2024 through November 3, 2025: 2 meetings, agendas and minutes for 1 meetings. Mt. Juliet Alcoholic Beverage Board (board) is captured from October 17, 2023 through September 8, 2026: 23 meetings, agendas and minutes for 22 meetings. Mt. Juliet Bicycle Pedestrian Advisory Committee (board) is captured from July 2, 2024 through October 6, 2026: 26 meetings, agendas. Mt. Juliet Parks and Greenways Board (board) is captured from July 2, 2024 through September 1, 2026: 15 meetings, agendas and minutes for 1 meetings. Mt. Juliet Real Estate Advisory Committee (board) is captured from August 26, 2025 through June 9, 2026: 2 meetings, agendas and minutes for 1 meetings. Mt. Juliet Traffic Commission (board) is captured from October 17, 2023 through April 15, 2025: 6 meetings, agendas and minutes for 5 meetings. Mt. Juliet Planning Commission (planning commission) is captured from May 18, 2023 through October 15, 2026: 37 meetings, agendas and minutes for 29 meetings. Note: 2021-01 to 2023-04 not located online -> records request for that window.

Watertown. Watertown Board of Zoning Appeals (board of zoning appeals) is not captured: its records are not posted online, so they must be requested from the clerk. Watertown City Council (elected board) is captured from August 20, 2024 through October 13, 2026: 30 meetings, agendas and minutes for 23 meetings. Watertown Beer Board (board) is captured from March 26, 2025 through September 9, 2026: 2 meetings, listings only; the portal lists records back to August 29, 2024, before the crawl window. Watertown Historic Preservation Commission (board) is captured from December 11, 2025 through May 21, 2026: 4 meetings, listings only; the portal lists records back to August 29, 2024, before the crawl window. Watertown Planning Commission (planning commission) is captured from September 17, 2024 through July 27, 2026: 6 meetings, agendas.

Gladeville Utility District. Gladeville Utility District Board of Commissioners (utility board) is not captured: no online record of its meetings could be found.

Lebanon Special School District. Lebanon Special School District Board of Education (school board) is captured from February 8, 2021 through October 20, 2026: 58 meetings, agendas and minutes.

Water & Wastewater Authority of Wilson County. Water & Wastewater Authority of Wilson County Board of Commissioners (utility board) is not captured: its records are not posted online, so they must be requested from the clerk.

West Wilson Utility District. West Wilson Utility District Board of Commissioners (utility board) is captured from July 10, 2023 through September 8, 2026: 39 meetings, agendas. Note: Agendas only (one PDF per month); minutes are not posted -> records request for minutes.

Wilson County Joint Economic and Community Development Board. Wilson County Joint Economic and Community Development Board (economic development board) is not captured: its records are not posted online, so they must be requested from the clerk.

Wilson County Schools. Wilson County Board of Education (school board) is captured from January 11, 2021 through October 15, 2026: 124 meetings, agendas.
